neighbours.label: Attributive 'selected' before a noun, meaning a chosen subset (selected topics, Selected Papers); the passive verb 'was selected' and other quantifiers stay quiet
fire: The journal printed a review of selected topics in soil chemistry.
This volume gathers selected essays from the author's final decade.
The museum lends selected works to regional galleries each year.
Readers will find Selected Letters of the poet in the library.
We discuss selected cases from the hospital's recent records.
The guide lists selected restaurants in each neighbourhood.
The exhibition catalogue includes a list of Selected Writings at the back.
Free delivery applies to selected items in our online shop.
quiet: The journal printed a review of recent topics in soil chemistry.
This volume gathers many essays from the author's final decade.
The museum lends several works to regional galleries each year.
Readers will find Complete Letters of the poet in the library.
We discuss typical cases from the hospital's recent records.
She was selected by the guide to review restaurants in each neighbourhood.
The exhibition catalogue includes a list of Early Writings at the back.
He was selected from the shop's staff to handle online delivery.
